replacements.new:
The original rulebook lists seven encounter phases in order: **Regroup, Destiny, Launch, Alliance, Planning, Reveal, Resolution**. The first encounter also has the Start Turn step before Regroup effects.

### Start Turn and hand replacement

replacements.old: Aim the gate at one planet in the indicated system; put one to four of your ships in it, drawn from any combination of your existing home and foreign colonies.
replacements.new: The offense chooses one planet in the destiny-indicated system and aims the gate at it. Place one to four offense ships on the **wide end of the hyperspace gate**, drawn from any combination of the offense's existing home and foreign colonies.

replacements.old: Each defensive ally also receives **one defender reward per ship contributed**. For each reward, draw one cosmic-deck card or retrieve one own warp ship to any own colony; combine these choices freely.
replacements.new: Each defensive ally must collect **one defender reward per ship contributed**. For each contributed ship, draw one cosmic-deck card or retrieve one own warp ship to any own colony; combine these choices freely. The ordinary rule does not permit declining these rewards.

replacements.old: may play them to add to **either side's total**, including the opposing side.
replacements.new: may play them to add the card's **printed amount to either side's total**, including the opposing side.
